summary: John's 4th great-aunt; eldest sister of Friedrich Mayer.
bio: Born 3 Jul 1821 in house No. 68 (tree says 7 Jul, probably the baptism). Godparents: the local citizens and masons Anton Mayer and Joseph Mayer (possible kin of Heinrich) and a single woman Anna [Rothenbacher?]. Married Joseph Wenz (b. 1828) at Munzingen 26 Feb 1857; children Mary Ann (1861) and Heinrich Wenz (1863–1943). Died 2 Apr 1872. A Joseph [Wenz?] witnessed Friedrich's 1862 marriage.
